leadText:
Pikachu Manor (Japanese: ピカチュウパレス Pikachu Palace) is an -exclusive location in Kalos, found between Laverre City and Dendemille Town. It was featured in Lights! Camera! Pika!.
 
Pikachu Manor is a large private estate owned by Frank, a movie director and enthusiast. As such, a lot of furniture and items inside resemble Pikachu, including a throne. The Manor contains many rooms including a private screening cinema and editing studio. and visited the Pikachu Manor when they met Frank and his granddaughter Jean, and helped them with Frank's latest production titled .

The estate also offers many scenic movie shooting locations like forests or lakes, and features Frank's village film set, Pikachu Land (Japanese: ピカチュウランド Pikachu Land).
